title: 1990s magazine exposé on assets moved from Area 51 to 'Area 52' at Dugway

tellings.quote: have been Popsai or Pop Mechanics. It was a huge expose on like Area 51 and how assets might have been moved over to Area 52, this mysterious new place in Dougway.

plain: In the 1990s, a magazine ran a big exposé claiming that secret things kept at Area 51, a hidden US Air Force test site in Nevada, may have been moved to a new place called "Area 52" at Dugway, a military testing ground in Utah. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb remembers the story from memory and is not sure whether it ran in Popular Science or Popular Mechanics. He brings it up as a hint that the most secret work may have left the famous base for a quieter one.
